The test image shows a cut tomato stem in a glass beaker of water. Key observations:
- Stem cross-section shows brown/dark internal vascular discoloration
- Milky/cloudy bacterial streaming visible in the water below the stem
- This is the classic **bacterial streaming diagnostic test** for Ralstonia solanacearum

This is strongly suggestive of bacterial wilt. Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference image is nearly identical to the test image — same diagnostic setup (cut stem in water beaker), same brown vascular discoloration, same milky bacterial streaming threads. Even the Bugwood IDs are consecutive (5606063 vs 5606064), confirming they're from the same series.
